Which exact flag do you mean (the GUC name)? Examples people sometimes refer to are "jit" / "enable_jit" or the various jit_* GUCs (jit_above_cost, jit_inline_above_age, etc.). If you tell me the exact name I’ll check the release notes and confirm whether it’s still only marked deprecated or has been removed.

Quick heads-up: recent PostgreSQL release notes mention changing JIT to be disabled by default, and the runtime-config docs still show the JIT configuration options. ([postgresql.org](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/19.0/?utm_source=openai))
